biotools.summary: JAAG is a web-based graphical interface designed to simplify the creation of JSON input files for AlphaFold 3, particularly when modeling glycans. It reduces errors and streamlines the process of integrating complex glycan structures into AlphaFold 3 simulations.

bioschemas.name: JAAG (JSON input file Assembler for AlphaFold 3 with Glycan integration)
